description:
Overview

???? Are you in Brazil, Argentina or Colombia? Join us as we actively recruit in these locations, offering a comfortable remote environment. Submit your CV in English, and we'll get back to you!

We invite a talented and proactive Intermediate Software Engineer with solid PHP experience and working knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React.js to join our team. You’ll work with a leading provider of payment processing and payroll solutions to help develop a robust human capital management (HCM) platform that streamlines HR processes, boosts employee engagement, and simplifies payroll.

What’s in it for you

  • Collaborate with a leading payment processing solution provider serving over 275,000 U.S. businesses
  • Join an international Agile team building a robust enterprise-grade platform
  • Expand your skills in PHP and JavaScript frameworks and gain exposure to cloud platforms like AWS and Azure

Is that you?

  • 4+ years of backend development experience with PHP
  • Hands-on frontend experience with Angular, React.js, or similar
  • Experience with MongoDB
  • Solid understanding of API integrations
  • Experience with unit testing and writing clean, maintainable code
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English level
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and stay focused on routine tasks
  • Adaptability, proactivity, and initiative in identifying issues and suggesting improvements
  • Strong sense of ownership and commitment to visibility

Desirable

In this role, you’ll join our dynamic team in building and maintaining key parts of our client\'s HCM platform.

Dev.Pro is a global company that’s been building great software since 2011. Our team values fairness, high standards, openness, and inclusivity for everyone — no matter your background. We pay in U.S. dollars and cover all approved overtime. Join English lessons and Dev.Pro University programs, and take part in fun online activities and team-building events.

description:
Overview

Grupo CPA Três Lagoas, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil

Vaga

ENGENHEIRO DE MACHINE LEARNING (SÊNIOR) | Grupo EasyLocal: 100% Home Office. Modalidade de Contratação: PJ ou Cooperado. Tempo de Projeto: Indeterminado.

Responsabilidades

  • Anotar e preparar datasets de visão computacional.
  • Projetar, treinar, validar e otimizar modelos de deep learning para classificação, detecção e segmentação de imagens.
  • Treinar e implementar modelos YOLO (You Only Look Once) para tarefas de detecção de objetos.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de inferência para execução eficiente em produção.
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps: CI/CD de modelos, versionamento de dados e experimentos, monitoramento e re-treino automático.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de software para integrar os modelos em sistemas e aplicações.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento de Python em quaisquer das bibliotecas de ML/DL (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).
  • Experiência prática com YOLO (treinamento e inferência em problemas de detecção de objetos).
  • Experiência sólida em visão computacional (classificação, detecção, segmentação).
  • Experiência em MLOps com quaisquer das ferramentas: AWS SageMaker Studio, MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, testes automatizados, ambientes reprodutíveis).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em dados estruturados: preparação de dataset, treinamento e inferência em problemas de regressão e classificação tabular.
  • Análise exploratória de dados estruturados (PCA, análise de correlação, clustering com K-Means).
  • Otimização de modelos para edge devices (TensorRT, ONNX, quantização).
  • Contribuições para projetos open source ou publicações técnicas.

Métricas e gráficos que deve saber interpretar

  • Visão computacional (foco principal): curvas PR e AP por classe, curva ROC e AUC, matriz de confusão, curvas de perda e acurácia durante o treinamento, distribuição de IoU (IoU).
  • Learning curves (treino vs. validação).
  • Dados estruturados (diferencial): gráficos de resíduos em regressão, curvas de calibração de probabilidade, feature importance, SHAP e PDP/ICE plots, heatmaps de correlação e PCA (scree plot, biplot).
  • MLOps / produção: gráficos de detecção de drift de dados, distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput e consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

Location and Flexibility

This role can be fully remote for candidates based in the states of São Paulo and Rio Grande do Sul as well as in the cities of Rio de Janeiro, and Belo Horizonte, due to team distribution and occasional in-person opportunities. If you are based in São Paulo or Porto Alegre, you are welcome to work from one of our offices on a flexible schedule.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital seeks a talented AI Engineer, driven to implement autonomous, intelligent, and analytical AI solutions that address complex business challenges. Your role is essential in bringing sophisticated GenAI and Software Engineering concepts and architectures into tangible, production-ready applications, enhancing digital products through autonomy, intelligence, and real-time adaptation.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate Generative AI models, including LLMs, with external APIs, tools, and databases using secure and efficient orchestration patterns.
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI workflows and Agentic AI solutions, enabling the seamless orchestration of intelligent agents to plan and perform tasks while leveraging autonomous and/or human-in-the-loop paradigms.
  • Implement and optimize multi-agent systems, leveraging standards and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging frameworks for agent interoperability.
  • Develop evaluation frameworks, metrics, and checkpoints for agent autonomy, performance, and safety, ensuring compliance with moderation, security, and ethical standards.
  • Ensure robust AI agent operations by applying observability, monitoring, and MLOps best practices, facilitating reliable deployment pipelines and continuous performance optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with data experts, orchestrating AI model selection, tuning, and performance validation to meet specific agent-based application needs.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts, systems, and decisions effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, promoting transparency and trust in AI delivery.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience designing and deploying AI architectures, with expertise in Generative AI, NLP, LLM integration, and software engineering.
  • Strong background in building software platforms (Python/Django, Java/Spring, TypeScript/Express, etc.) capable of API integration and orchestration.
  • Strong understanding of the trade-offs between various generative AI models and the ability to choose the right model for specific use cases.
  • Hands-on experience with function-calling and tools integration into LLM models, leveraging frameworks such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Expertise in data embeddings, vector databases, and chunking strategies, understanding the trade-off between different options, and leveraging it to optimize data ingestion and application performance.
  • Experience using CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS CodeDeploy, Azure Pipelines) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying software on leading cloud platforms and utilizing AI tools like AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Services.
  • Experience leveraging evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, OpenAI Eval) and tools (e.g., DeepEval, LangSmith, Braintrust) to assess business and performance metrics of AI solutions.
  • Understanding of performance optimization, including the use of observability platforms, event tracking, and performance validation.
  • Practical knowledge of deploying AI solutions using cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP, utilizing services such as AWS Bedrock or Azure AI Services.
  • Excellent skills in prompt and context engineering, ensuring the usage of the right techniques to meet diverse project requirements.
  • Ability to communicate complex AI solutions and concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Agentic AI orchestration frameworks such as Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, or others.
  • Experience with advanced Agentic AI architecture, performance optimization of machine learning models, and the integration of AI into larger software ecosystems.
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI solutions using containers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes to ensure scalability, reliability, and efficient resource management.
  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale data-intensive solutions, maintaining high throughput, low latency, and data security.

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you'll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter. We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

Quais desafios nós temos para você?

A área de serviços tem como foco prestar consultoria e apoio aos clientes e fazer com que o processo de implantação dos nossos sistemas sejam o mais suave possível. Para isso, precisamos nos preparar, nos antecipar em possíveis situações que possam ocorrer e já mitigar os riscos identificados. Tudo isso exige muito planejamento e constante busca por conhecimento. A área de projetos é super desafiadora e dinâmica, possibilitando grande aprendizado do negócio de software e dos nossos clientes.

  • Instalação e configuração do sistema: O analista instala o software nos servidores do cliente e realiza as configurações necessárias para o funcionamento adequado.
  • Migração de dados: Em muitos casos, é necessário migrar dados de sistemas antigos para o novo sistema. O analista garante que a migração seja feita de forma segura e precisa.
  • Testes: Após a instalação e configuração, o analista realiza testes para verificar se o sistema está funcionando corretamente e se atende aos requisitos do cliente.
  • Treinamento de usuários: O analista ministra treinamentos para os usuários do sistema, ensinando-os a utilizar as funcionalidades e a realizar as tarefas do dia a dia.
  • Suporte pós-implantação: Após a implantação, o analista oferece suporte técnico aos usuários, auxiliando na resolução de problemas e dúvidas.
  • Documentação do processo: O analista documenta todas as etapas do processo de implantação, desde o planejamento até o suporte pós-implantação.
  • Relatórios de progresso: O analista elabora relatórios de progresso, informando o status da implantação e os resultados obtidos.

Requisitos para você mover o varejo junto com a gente :

  • Gostar de pessoas e de construir boas relações.

  • Resiliência diante de desafios e disposição para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Afinidade com tecnologia e curiosidade para aprender continuamente.

Diferenciais que fazem brilhar os olhos:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou Contabilidade.
  • Experiência em implantação de softwares.
  • Vivência com consultoria e/ou capacitação de pessoas.

Como você pode contar com a gente?

Desenvolvemos sistemas robustos e eficientes que são cruciais para o funcionamento das unidades industriais, centros de distribuição e oficinas internacionais.

Nosso foco é garantir que a tecnologia esteja sempre alinhada com as melhores práticas e tendências do mercado, diferenciando-nos estrategicamente dos concorrentes. Estamos comprometidos em melhorar continuamente nossos processos e produtos para fornecer um suporte técnico de excelência que aumente a competitividade da Minerva Foods.

As soluções desenvolvidas pela nossa equipe impactam diretamente o EBITDA da empresa, garantindo que as decisões estratégicas e operacionais sejam fundamentadas em sistemas confiáveis e inovadores. Mantemos um diálogo contínuo com a camada executiva e estamos engajados em promover mudanças que aperfeiçoem nossa cultura e processos internos. Através de nossa dedicação à excelência em desenvolvimento de software, direcionamos a Minerva Foods para um futuro tecnicamente avançado e operacionalmente eficiente.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Participação de projetos transversais às diretorias, atuando no ciclo completo de seu desenvolvimento: identificação de oportunidade, definição de escopo, idealização de solução, acompanhamento e report do andamento do projeto, validação de solução proposta, capacitação de usuários e suporte para dúvidas do produto desenvolvido;
  • Ser capaz de questionar e argumentar de forma coerente e construtiva com equipes clientes (Analistas, Coordenadores e Gestores) para contribuir na definição do escopo de projetos de TI. Traduzir as necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas de desenvolvimento de sistemas, considerando as melhores práticas em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Ágil. Apresentar, de maneira clara e recorrente, o progresso e os resultados dos projetos em andamento;

title: Consultor de Sucesso do Cliente II
description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Activesoft é referência nacional em soluções de gestão e tecnologia para escolas, oferecendo um ERP completo que otimiza a eficiência operacional e financeira das instituições de ensino. ClassApp , por sua vez, nasceu com o propósito de transformar a educação por meio de um relacionamento mais próximo entre escolas e famílias e, hoje, impacta mais de 1.300 escolas e 1 milhão de usuários , consolidando-se como líder no segmento. Já o isaac atua como parceiro financeiro das escolas, trazendo previsibilidade de caixa, liquidez imediata e soluções que fortalecem a sustentabilidade das instituições de ensino.

Juntas, essas soluções compõem a vertical de Finanças & Gestão da Arco Educação , unindo eficiência operacional, inovação tecnológica, proximidade no relacionamento escolar e saúde financeira para impulsionar o sucesso das instituições em todo o país.

Estamos em busca de Consultores de Customer Success , que serão responsáveis por atuar diretamente com escolas de diferentes perfis, conduzindo relacionamentos consultivos de alto impacto. Esses profissionais terão como missão apoiar na adoção das nossas soluções, impulsionar a expansão de oportunidades e garantir a retenção dos clientes, sempre com foco em resultados e geração de valor.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Gestão de Relacionamento atuando como ponto de contato principal com os clientes, monitorando o Health Score e agindo proativamente para otimizar indicadores de sucesso;
  • Retenção e Fidelização desenvolvendo estratégias para engajar continuamente os clientes e reforçar o valor das soluções oferecidas;
  • Upsell e Cross-Sell explorando oportunidades de expansão e promovendo o uso de novas funcionalidades e serviços complementares.
  • Implantação e Onboarding acompanhando e orientando clientes durante a implantação inicial das soluções, garantindo uma integração fluida e bem-sucedida;
  • Churn e Reversão detectando sinais de insatisfação, atuando rapidamente na solução de problemas e conduzindo negociações para retenção.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em Customer Success, atuando com grandes contas em operações de ciclo longo.
  • Visão analítica e tomada de decisão orientada por indicadores como NPS, churn e expansão de receita.
  • Atuação que vá além da gestão de carteira, contribuindo para a estruturação da operação de CS.
  • Gestão ativa de clientes, com análise crítica de dados e KPIs.
  • Experiência com produtos complexos (SaaS ou sistemas com múltiplos módulos).
  • Vivência em estratégias de expansão, retenção e geração de valor, com viés comercial.
  • Capacidade técnica ou visão clara de priorização e escalabilidade dentro da operação.
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash benefícios - R$40,50/dia útil);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação para o colaborador;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa.

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Activesoft - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito.

Declaração de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

Quando você se candidata a uma das nossas vagas, você nos fornece vários dados pessoais. Ao final do processo seletivo, armazenamos o seu currículo em um banco de currículos, para o caso de surgirem novas vagas que tenham aderência ao seu perfil.

description:
Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

We are looking for a detail-oriented, customer-obsessed Benefits Associate, Operations to join our growing Benefits Operations team. This role is pivotal in supporting the day-to-day delivery of employee benefits programs across multiple countries. As a Benefits Coordinator, you will provide administrative and operational support to ensure our employees and clients enjoy a seamless, informed, and positive benefits experience.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with early experience in HR or benefits administration who is looking to grow in a global, mission-driven organization.

What you bring

  • Experienced in employee benefits, HR operations, or a similar administrative role.
  • Strong customer service skills with clear written and verbal communication.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle high-volume tasks accurately.
  • Solid organizational and time management skills; able to meet deadlines and shift priorities.
  • Comfortable working on multiple tools like Zendesk, Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Empathetic and professional when interacting with employees and clients.
  • Solution-oriented and eager to improve processes and service delivery.
  • Team player with a collaborative mindset and openness to feedback.

Key responsibilities

  • Respond to employee and client queries related to benefits via Zendesk and email.
  • Deliver clear, empathetic, and informative support across topics like plan details, enrollment, claims, and billing.
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately and collaborate with Benefits Specialists to ensure resolution.
  • Accurately handle benefits data: validation, updates, and preparation for reporting.
  • Support enrollment and changes (e.g. new joiners, life events, terminations) in both internal and external benefits systems.
  • Assist with invoice audits and data checks, collaborating with the Accounting team to support accurate payment processing.
  • Maintain invoice tracking datasets accurately on a monthly basis.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Payroll, Legal, Lifecycle, and Finance, and ask for support when needed.
  • Support regular audits and data quality reviews across systems.
  • Track and escalate exceptions or inaccuracies, working with the Quality Analyst and Benefits Specialists.
  • Maintain internal documentation (in Notion or other tools) to reflect updates and recurring learnings.
  • Suggest improvements to benefits FAQs or support articles to enhance clarity for internal or external users.
  • Be an internal and external champion of Remote's values and Benefits team's goals.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager, Benefits Operations

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We aim to pay above in-location rates and support global talent-hiring. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

We foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. All compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is

$26,100 - $58,700 USD

Remote is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we prioritize a sense of belonging.

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  • Please fill out the form below and upload your CV in PDF format.
  • Submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use at Remote.
  • If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested, you may add a LinkedIn profile.

Remote is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants from all ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, and backgrounds to apply. We are open to accommodations during the interview process upon request.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

A CPFL Energia está há 110 anos no setor elétrico e atua nos segmentos de distribuição, geração, transmissão, comercialização e serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, estatal chinesa que é a terceira maior organização empresarial do mundo e a maior empresa de energia elétrica, atendendo 88% do território chinês.

O grupo CPFL conta ainda com uma operação nacional por meio da CPFL Soluções, fornecendo soluções integradas em gestão e comercialização de energia, eficiência energética, geração distribuída, infraestrutura energética, serviços de consultoria para descarbonização e certificações de energia renovável (I-REC).

Aqui na Viaflow, atuamos 100% remoto e nesta oportunidade você será responsável por testar e aperfeiçoar soluções e softwares, em diferentes e complexos cenários.

Se identificou? Então vem com a gente!

O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Experiência com processos de qualidade (critérios de aceite, elaboração de cenários de teste);
  • Experiência com análise de requisitos (funcionais e não funcionais);
  • Experiência com ferramentas para reportes e gestão de bugs (Jira, Mantis, DevOps);
  • Experiência com Testes Manuais e de Integração;
  • Experiência com Testes Funcionais;
  • Experiência nos processos de planejamento, estimativa e controle de entrega;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de teste de APIs (Postman, SoapUI, Robot Framework, Python, BDD, Gherkin);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados SQL.

E o que será um diferencial?

  • Conhecimento de previdência privada aberta
  • Testes Automatizados, por exemplo: E2E, Componente, API, Unitários, Mobile;
  • Conhecimento em Selenium, Cucumber, Cypress;
  • Formação na área (concluída ou em andamento);
  • Experiência em banco de dados não relacional (no-SQL).

E aqui estão as suas principais responsabilidades no dia a dia:

  • Executar processos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos, que previnam problemas e garantam a conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos;
  • Elaborar e executar planos de testes abrangentes, considerando diferentes tipos de testes (funcionais, não funcionais, de desempenho, etc.) e metodologias;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e técnicas de testes manuais e automatizadas para identificar falhas em softwares, sistemas e produtos tecnológicos;
  • Documentar detalhadamente os testes realizados, incluindo falhas encontradas;
  • Analisar as falhas identificadas durante os testes, determinando a causa raiz e o impacto na entrega final;
  • Classificar as falhas de acordo com a severidade e prioridade, considerando o impacto nos usuários e no negócio;
  • Reportar as falhas à equipe de desenvolvimento de forma clara e concisa, utilizando ferramentas adequadas de gerenciamento de defeitos;
  • Acompanhar o processo de correção das falhas reportadas, garantindo que sejam solucionadas de forma eficaz e dentro do prazo previsto;
  • Realizar retestes após a correção das falhas para garantir que o problema foi solucionado e não introduziu novas falhas;
  • Auxiliar na identificação e implementação de melhorias nos processos de desenvolvimento e testes, visando aumentar a qualidade e a eficiência do trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento na definição de padrões de qualidade para softwares, sistemas e produtos tecnológicos;
  • Manter uma comunicação clara e eficaz com a equipe de desenvolvimento, stakeholders e outros departamentos envolvidos no projeto;
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada e colaborativa com as demais estruturas da empresa, visando o compartilhamento de conhecimento entre todas as equipes;
  • Buscar a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos processos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Participar dos ritos ágeis da equipe: Daily, Planning, Review, entre outros;
  • Manter as ferramentas de gerenciamento dos projetos atualizadas - status das atividades, apropriação de horas, etc.

Curtiu a oportunidade? Cadastre seu currículo e venha construir o futuro com a gente!

title: Banco de Talentos: Oportunidades CLT
description:
Esta é uma oportunidade para você fazer parte de nosso banco de talentos no Infnet . Mas o que é isso?

O banco de talentos é uma forma de você enviar seu currículo e já realizar algumas etapas comuns aos processos seletivos do corpo técnico administrativo. Assim, quando surgir uma vaga alinhada ao seu perfil, você já sai na frente.

Este banco de talentos não é para professores, instrutores, trainees ou estagiários.

  • As vagas para o corpo técnico administrativo têm carga horária de 44 horas semanais , usualmente de segunda a sexta-feira.

  • Oportunidade de continuar os estudos na instituição, com direito a bolsas para graduação e pós-graduação .
  • Ambiente universitário que favorece seu aprendizado , com acesso à biblioteca para estudos e networking com professores e profissionais da área.

Para estas vagas, os candidatos devem ter bom nível de atenção e demonstrar habilidades de comunicação .

  • Secretaria e Registro Acadêmico
  • Recursos Humanos, R&S e DP
  • TI e Suporte
  • Desenvolvimento de Software
  • Infraestrutura e manutenção

Estes requisitos são comuns para todas as vagas deste banco de talentos:

Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Ser capaz de se comunicar por escrito com clareza e sem erros de português
  • Ter bom raciocínio lógico e um bom nível de atenção na execução de tarefas
  • Proatividade, postura profissional e responsabilidade
  • Facilidade no aprendizado de softwares
  • Domínio das ferramentas Google, especialmente Documentos e Planilhas

Todas as vagas contam com os seguintes benefícios:

  • Vale-transporte, para os dias de trabalho presencial
  • Vale-refeição em cartão flexível Swile
  • Plano de saúde pela Unimed ou Amil e plano odontológico pela Amil
  • Dia livre de aniversário a partir de um ano de casa
  • Possibilidade de participar dos cursos oferecidos pela instituição em condições especiais para colaboradores, incluindo bolsas integrais de graduação após o período de experiência e bolsas parciais de pós-graduação
  • Possibilidade de bolsa para dependentes e/ou cônjuge após dois anos de trabalho na instituição

Conheça mais sobre o Instituto Infnet

O Instituto Infnet é uma instituição de ensino de alto nível e orientada ao mercado de trabalho sediada no Rio de Janeiro. É composta pela Faculdade Infnet e pela ECDD (Escola de Comunicação e Design Digital). Fundado em 1994, o Instituto cresceu junto com a Internet no Brasil, acompanhando toda a sua evolução e sendo um importante pivô para sua difusão.

A Faculdade Infnet é referência em engenharias tech. Oferece cursos de graduação e pós-graduação a distância e presenciais em áreas como Engenharia e Desenvolvimento de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Redes e Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de Banco de Dados, Ciência de Dados e Inteligência Artificial. Possui sede no Centro do Rio de Janeiro, próximo à estação Carioca.

A ECDD (Escola de Comunicação e Design Digital) é a faculdade dos criativos. Oferece programas de graduação e pós-graduação a distância e presenciais, todos na área de criação. Os principais campos dos cursos são Design Gráfico e Digital, Publicidade e Marketing, Design de Games, Design de Animação, Cinema e Audiovisual. A ECDD também fica sediada no Centro do Rio de Janeiro, em um charmoso prédio tombado pelo Corredor Cultural.

Main responsibilities

  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de vendas, como volume, faturamento e rentabilidade, para garantir o alcance das metas estabelecidas, identificar oportunidades de melhoria no desempenho do canal e implementar ações corretivas que impulsionem os resultados comerciais e a eficiência operacional.
  • Gerir as contas (verbas) de cada cliente, garantindo que permaneçam positivas, assegurando que as ações de vendas sejam contínuas e sustentáveis, e promovendo um crescimento constante nas vendas dentro da região de atuação, alinhado às metas comerciais e à estratégia da empresa.
  • Estudar o mercado local e identificar oportunidades de crescimento, ajustando as estratégias de vendas para aproveitar as demandas específicas da região, maximizando o potencial de mercado e impulsionando o desempenho comercial.
  • Estabelecer e negociar preços, prazos e políticas de vendas com os distribuidores, buscando acordos mutuamente benéficos que garantam condições favoráveis para ambas as partes e impulsionem o crescimento do canal.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho do canal indireto, avaliando os resultados alcançados, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo ações corretivas ou estratégias de expansão para otimizar os resultados comerciais.
  • Assegurar que os distribuidores mantenham níveis adequados de estoque e que a logística esteja devidamente alinhada, garantindo um atendimento eficiente à demanda e evitando rupturas ou excessos de inventário.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as áreas de marketing, logística e financeira para alinhar as ações e garantir o suporte adequado aos parceiros, promovendo uma execução eficiente das estratégias e assegurando o alcance dos objetivos comerciais.
  • Atuar em conformidade com os procedimentos internos (POP, IT, Manual, Políticas), garantindo a execução segura, ética e com qualidade das atividades, conforme as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa. Participar ativamente de treinamentos, processos de melhoria contínua e reuniões relacionadas aos sistemas de gestão, além de cumprir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no trabalho e o código de conduta, com o objetivo de assegurar a credibilidade dos processos, promover a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e garantir a excelência nos resultados.

The ImPactis a US-based nonprofit organization with team members spread around the world.We are looking for a Community Manager to lead the growth and support of our member community in Latin America. This is a remote full-time position and we are looking for candidates based in Brazil, Chile, or Mexico.

The Community Manager will report to The ImPact’s Director of Community based in Santiago, Chile and will work closely with the Senior Director for community growth and support.

The Community Manager for Latin America will develop a vision and strategy for The ImPact’s community growth, support, and engagement with the surrounding impact ecosystem in the region, in alignment with The ImPact’s global vision and strategy. The Community Manager for Latin America will be responsible for developing a financial and operational plan pursuant to the regional vision and strategy, including the gathering of mission-aligned revenues alongside member contributions. The Community Manager for Latin America will also design and deliver individual support and collaborative experiences for the members in their region to help them make more impact investing more effectively. Overall, the Community Manager for Latin America is responsible and accountable for the setting and accomplishment of membership growth and engagement targets within their region, in alignment with The ImPact’s global goals.

We are a global, remote team with team members based in the US, France, Chile, and Singapore. We work across multiple time zones and our core ways of working are anchored in a combination of virtual synchronous meetings and asynchronous discussion and collaboration in writing and using other virtual collaborative tools. We also believe that consistent in-person connection and collaboration is important - for relationship building, team members’ professional growth, and effective work. Our global team meets in-person at least once a year at a team retreat or our global, annual member events.

The ImPact offers competitive salaried compensation, commensurate with experience and location, and generous benefits that vary by labor market.

Primary Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Relationship Management (40%): You will build strong and authentic relationships with all of The ImPact’s members based in Latin America, developing a deep understanding of their individual and family impact investment interests and areas of need. You will develop a customized plan of membership for each individual member that will provide the experiences, best practices, and relationships to support them in making progress towards their impact goals and have regular conversations with the members. You will forge connections among these members to best serve their individual and collective needs and facilitate peer-to-peer exchange of knowledge, data, and insights.
  • Member Recruitment (30%) : You will actively identify families who could benefit from and contribute to The ImPact’s unique peer-to-peer community through individual and collaborative outreach withThe ImPact’s global team and current members. You will work with the Director of Community to set regional growth targets and help open the funnel through distribution channel partnerships and participating in regional events. You are also responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for prospective members, including assessing their initial interest and fit, coordinating the member endorsement process, supporting the formal invitation process, and conducting onboarding with new members.
  • Curation of Local & Global Experiences (25%): You will be responsible for developing a robust yearly calendar of experiences for members and prospective members in the region, selecting themes, curating content, and ensuring strong participation from members and prospective members. These experiences are designed to build lasting and productive relationships among members, provide knowledge and insights, and enable each participant to advance their own impact investing activities. You will also work with the global team to design, create, or adapt tools or other educational resources that deepen members’ knowledge of impact investing or enable them to take specific actions related to implementing their impact investment strategies.
  • Building Regional Strategy and Partnerships (5%) : You will set annual and quarterly Objectives and Key Results for Latin America as a whole. title: Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities (detailed)

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

Main qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

description:
About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Fará aplicação de processos e práticas estabelecidos para melhorar a eficácia e documentar os procedimentos do programa de referência por parte dos funcionários. Coordenará atividades com múltiplas variáveis, definirá prazos realistas e fará o gerenciamento de cronograma.

O Coordenador será ponto de contato para consultas sobre as atividades do programa e poderá auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais de comunicação do programa e gerenciamento de correspondência. Esta posição trabalhará em cooperação com a equipe da Conservação, fornecendo informações necessárias para tomar decisões e resolver problemas. O Coordenador atuará como responsável pelo departamento conforme designado pela supervisão, a fim de coordenar arranjos, transmitir informações e garantir a execução bem-sucedida do programa direcionado relacionado à área funcional da equipe. O Coordenador e comunicará com a equipe de vários programas em toda a Conservancy, bem como com doadores, voluntários, fornecedores e relações comerciais. Ele comunicará ou distribuirá informações para ajudar a equipe a tomar decisões, resolver problemas e melhorar o fluxo de trabalho.

Você está procurando um trabalho em que possa acreditar? Assim, buscamos alguém com mente criativa, que se adapte facilmente a tratativa dos diversos temas, perfis e áreas. title: Head of Recovery Strategy, Process and Programs
description:
About Upstart

Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while delivering the digital-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.

Upstart is a digital-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.

Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!

The Team

The Recovery team at Upstart is responsible for maximizing post-default recoveries while ensuring compliant, borrower-centric engagement across a diverse and growing vendor ecosystem. As our Recovery operations mature, we are investing in building smarter, more scalable systems that reduce manual risk, improve data-driven decisions, and align our vendor network with long-term strategic outcomes.

We are seeking a Head of Recovery Strategy, Process & Programs to lead our transformation roadmap across vendor integration, automation, compliance infrastructure, and intelligent placement logic. This individual will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data Analytics, and Operations to architect the next evolution of Recovery operations at Upstart.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead Recovery’s transformation roadmap: Design and deliver high-impact initiatives that reduce manual risk, automate vendor workflows, and scale internal process efficiency across legal recovery, bankruptcy, affidavits, DSC, debt sales, and probate.
  • Architect scalable vendor infrastructure: Enhance frameworks for vendor onboarding, integration, compliance scorecards, and audit-readiness, ensuring Recovery is built to scale intelligently across a growing multi-vendor ecosystem.
  • Quantify and optimize placement strategy: Partner with data analytics, ML, and operations to improve liquidation and cost-to-collect through segmentation logic, hypothesis-driven testing, and performance-based routing.
  • Drive analytical and cross-functional execution: Lead strategic programs from concept to implementation—including the rollout of tools like Convoke, legal collections testing, and compliance health models—grounded in measurable ROI and portfolio-level impact.
  • Own Recovery’s strategic alignment layer: Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Legal, ML, and Ops to ensure programs are modeled, implemented, and monitored with discipline.
  • Enable performance & quality execution, not manage it: This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You'll complement operational leadership by enabling managers with scalable tools, systems, and decision frameworks—not by running day-to-day vendor performance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product strategy, operations, or transformation program leadership in a regulated or financial services environment
  • Proven success leading analytically rigorous initiatives involving ROI modeling, hypothesis-driven testing, and cost-benefit analysis while leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving vendors, risk/compliance, and technology teams
  • Demonstrated ability to estimate financial impact at the unit and portfolio level (e.g., revenue per transaction, net present value over time)
  • Demonstrated experience applying process design, automation, or analytics to solve operational problems
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to organize and drive multiple workstreams
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and present recommendations
  • Excellent communicator: able to synthesize complex analyses into clear, actionable roadmaps
  • Proven analytical skills, with the ability to monitor performance metrics and make data-driven decisions
  • Familiarity with compliance and operational risk frameworks in regulated financial operations
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a strong sense of urgency

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comfort building and interpreting unit economics models , breakeven analysis, and performance scenarios
  • Experience leading or collaborating on ML- or rule-based segmentation strategies for operational decisioning
  • Strong fluency with quantitative tools (SQL, Excel modeling, Looker, or scripting languages)
  • MBA from a top-tier business school
  • 3+ years of People management experience
  • Strong familiarity with regulated financial services operations or collections/recovery environments
  • Experience in legal collections, recovery optimization, debt sale analytics, or servicing vendor strategy
  • Immense curiosity about root causes—thinks critically from first principles and never stops asking questions
  • A natural thought-partner: open-minded, collaborative, and able to co-create new ideas with cross-functional teams
  • Experience working in fintech, financial services, or consulting (e.g. strategy, risk, vendor management)
  • Familiarity with tools like Convoke, Salesforce, AppScript, or vendor audit and control software
  • Experience with compliance, vendor due diligence, or regulatory exam preparation

Position location

This role is available in the following locations: Remote.

Time zone requirements

The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements

As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

What you\'ll love

  • Competitive Compensation (base + bonus & equity)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to $4,500 and immediate vesting and after-tax savings
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Generous holiday, vacation, sick and safety leave
  • Supportive parental, family care, and military leave programs
  • Annual wellness, technology & ergonomic reimbursement programs
  • Social activities including team events and onsites, all-company updates, employee resource groups (ERGs), and other interest groups such as book clubs, fitness, investing, and volunteering
  • Catered lunches + snacks & drinks when working in offices

description:
Overview

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você. Em Impostos , estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros. #TaxEY
Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida em Campinas. #hybrid

Como Gerente Tributário/a Sênior, você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar áreas de riscos, oportunidades de planejamento sustentável ao longo do ciclo de vida dos impostos indiretos e apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações de conformidade e metas de negócios em todo o mundo.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

  • Liderar e participar de vários projetos de consultoria na área de VAT, oferecendo assistência na identificação de áreas de risco e oportunidades de planejamento sustentável em tributos em todas as etapas de incidência de impostos, ajudando os clientes a cumprir suas obrigações de compliance e seus objetivos de negócios;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com o cliente ao longo do ano. Estabelecer expectativas de valor a ser produzido como resultado;
  • Manter-se informado/a sobre os desenvolvimentos econômicos e corporativos gerais e seu impacto para o cliente;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, incentivando-as a refletir e a assumir responsabilidade por suas contribuições à equipe. Delegar trabalho de forma bem-sucedida, conduzindo revisões de desempenho de forma tempestiva e fornecer feedback/treinamento com relação ao desempenho apresentado;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa;
  • Manter relacionamentos de cooperação com outras equipes de trabalho. Monitorar o progresso da equipe de trabalho com relação ao planejamento e fazer alterações quando necessário.
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio. Ter um bom entendimento sobre a EY e suas linhas de serviço e avaliar/apresentar de forma ativa maneiras para a aplicação do conhecimento e dos serviços da empresa. Desenvolver relacionamentos duradouros tanto dentro como fora da empresa.

Por que você?

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS e ISS);
  • Habilidades de gestão de projetos;

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Experiência em projetos de compliance e/ou planejamento, análise e revisão de procedimentos fiscais, levantamento de créditos tributários, elaboração de relatórios e consultas sobre questões tributárias e fiscais e reestruturação de operações;
  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
  • Expertise em elaboração de propostas técnicas e desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

title: Client Manager
description:
Overview

Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. We are reimagining what’s possible in our industry with a configurable, AI-powered platform and expert support. This role is full remote, located in California, and part of the Customer Success Team as a Client Manager focusing on client interactions, processes, and improving client success within our payment integrity platform.

The ideal hire will ensure timely issue resolution and take action on anticipated client needs to deliver value, collaborating with operational and technical teams to optimize success and deliver the best value to our clients through strong support strategies.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure the Machinify team delivers value to clients through efficient operational processes, enhanced reporting, comprehensive user training, and exceptional support strategies
  • Help create and drive execution on client strategy including intentional relationship building and supporting growth expansion initiatives
  • Identify actionable insights from healthcare claims data and results
  • Project financial results and company revenue based on KPI data and business dynamics
  • Review all client-facing reporting for accuracy, including reporting that covers: impacts of policy customizations or modifications; comparing actual results to expectations; trends by product, line of business, policy, providers, etc.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the assigned client’s organizational structure, business objectives, and opportunities, translating that into a value proposition Machinify can deliver against
  • Generate materials and reporting to deliver insights to the customer and demonstrate program performance against key success metrics
  • Document and provide organizational visibility to key internal stakeholders on insights, risks, and client activities and expectations; track progress of initiatives
  • Work with leadership to communicate actionable findings to support client understanding of the data
  • Become an expert on company platform(s) to support client workflow, delivery, and user onboarding and training
  • Introduce new functionality and capabilities and obtain product feedback for the Product team
  • Support client contracting efforts and SLA management
  • Monitor solution performance and deliver quantifiable and qualitative insights to customers via regular meetings and reviews
  • Act as a key contact for client inquiries, support, and all key deliverables
  • Occasional travel requirements up to 25% of the year to meet client needs

Role Requirements

  • 5-7 years in client-facing roles (client management, customer success, or similar)
  • Proven track record for cultivating and influencing relationships within the healthcare payer market
  • Previous experience in the healthcare Payment Integrity space highly preferred
  • Analytical strength to observe, understand questions, and explain answers in healthcare claims data
  • Excellent communication skills, adept at presenting materials and speaking on topics extemporaneously
  • Ability to work with a range of individuals and manage multiple requests with fast turnaround
  • Driven self-starter mindset, eager to collaborate in a cross-functional environment
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate autonomously
  • High attention to detail and process orientation
  • Holds a high level of integrity

What Success Looks Like…

After 3 months

  • You will have a strong understanding of the role
  • You will begin building relationships and collaborating with peers
  • You will develop effective time and priorities management
  • You will receive initial feedback and use it to improve
  • You will gain confidence and feel more comfortable in your role

After 1 year

  • You have mastered the tasks and responsibilities of the position with confidence and efficiency
  • You have established a strong network of internal relationships and are recognized as a key collaborator
  • You’ve been entrusted with greater responsibility indicating company confidence in your abilities
  • You see opportunities for career progression and personal development

Pay range : $130,000-$175,000 USD; role is eligible for Annual Performance Bonus

This is an exempt position. The salary range is for Base Salary. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and geographic location.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Eligibility for health, vision, and dental coverage, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Eligibility for company-paid benefits including life insurance, short-term disability, and parental leave
  • Remote and hybrid work options

What values we’ll share with you

  • Ask why
  • Think big
  • Be humble
  • Optimize for customer impact
  • Deliver results

At Machinify, we’re reimagining a simpler way forward. We are innovators who value integrity, teamwork, accuracy, and flexibility. We do the right thing and listen to client needs. We champion diverse perspectives to better serve our clients.

Our values come to life through our culture. We embrace flexible work arrangements and cross-functional collaboration. We invest in ongoing education and team celebrations, and we give back through volunteering. Machinify is dedicated to making healthcare work better for everyone.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Machinify is an employment-at-will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by law. We do not inquire about salary history during recruitment. title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Role and Responsibilities

  • We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.
  • This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.
  • Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.
